ability.title: Ability Explorer
ability.subtitle: Select the category to begin. Start with what you want

descriptions.cognitive: Focus on reasoning, analysis, and mental agility.
descriptions.physical: Evaluate strength, endurance, and coordination abilities.
descriptions.psychomotor: Explore precision, timing, and movement-based abilities.
descriptions.sensory: Assess perception-based abilities such as vision and hearing.

knowledge.title: Knowledge Explorer
knowledge.subtitle: Select the category to begin. Start with what you want

descriptions.artsHumanities: Explore language, history, culture, and creative expression.
descriptions.businessManagement: Focus on leadership, operations, and organizational strategy.
descriptions.communications: Assess media, broadcasting, and information-sharing interests.
descriptions.educationTraining: Look at teaching, coaching, and learning support interests.
descriptions.engineeringTechnology: Explore design, construction, and technical innovation topics.
descriptions.healthServices: Understand healthcare, wellness, and medical knowledge areas.
descriptions.lawSafety: Consider law, governance, and public safety domains.
descriptions.manufacturingProduction: Explore production processes and quality control knowledge.
descriptions.mathScience: Focus on scientific inquiry, mathematics, and research interests.
descriptions.transportation: Assess interest in logistics, navigation, and transportation systems.

skills.title: Skill Test
skills.subtitleLine1: Select a skill category to begin the assessment.
skills.subtitleLine2: You can start with the category that you want.

basic.title: Basic Skills
basic.description: Fundamental capacities that facilitate learning or the more rapid acquisition of knowledge

content.title: Content Skills
content.description: Background structures needed to work with and acquire more specific skills in a variety of different domains

process.title: Process Skills
process.description: Procedures that contribute to the more rapid acquisition of knowledge and skill across a variety of domains

crossFunctional.title: Cross-functional Skills
crossFunctional.description: Developed capacities that facilitate performance of activities that occur across jobs

complexProblemSolving.title: Complex Problem Solving
complexProblemSolving.description: Developed capacities used to solve novel, ill-defined problems in complex, real-world settings

resourceManagement.title: Resource Management
resourceManagement.description: Developed capacities used to allocate resources efficiently

social.title: Social Skills
social.description: Developed capacities used to work with people to achieve goals

systems.title: Systems Skills
systems.description: Developed capacities used to understand, monitor, and improve socio-technical systems

technical.title: Technical Skills
technical.description: Developed capacities used to design, set-up, operate, and correct malfunctions involving application of machines or technological systems
